title: UNI per-UNI observation surface (producer v1a)
description: Response contract for the four read-only routes on the uni-producer Phoenix node: GET /producer/uni_roster, /producer/uni_state/:name, /producer/uni_history/:name, /producer/generations. Every payload is a SUBSTRATE-LEVEL OBSERVATION read verbatim from SP.Runtime.Board. Gate: producer-per-uni-telemetry. THE FENCE: no response may contain a synthesized aggregate score, rank, percentage, health index, or any value the producer itself derived beyond regrouping the board's own fields — the gate FALSIFIES on exactly that, and on any response missing the disclaimer.

disclaimer.const: substrate observation only; no evidence for awareness/experience — see LAB_PROTOCOL claim fence
disclaimer.description: MANDATORY on every response, and mirrored in the x-uni-claim-fence response header. Removing it FALSIFIES the gate.

uniEntry.description: One UNI as the board sees it. All fields are observations; none is a score.

username.description: Board-authoritative name, e.g. UNI-1-3 or UNI-1-g4.

kin.description: Kin group 0..9. THE FIRST NUMBER IN THE NAME IS THE KIN GROUP, NOT A GENERATION.

index.description: Monotonic per-kin index for Colony-spawned UNIs (UNI-<kin>-<idx>). null for lineage-bred names.

lineage_generation.description: True breeding generation. Present ONLY for SP.Runtime.Lineage names (UNI-<kin>-g<gen>). null means this UNI was Colony-spawned and carries no generation — it does NOT mean generation 0.

mode.description: Social visibility mode governing this UNI's perception of others.

phase.description: Curriculum phase reached (0 survive .. 4 shelter). An observation of the genome's phase field.

action.description: Last committed primitive action written to the body Port.

ticks.description: Count of completed predict-act cycles for this life.

mindBeat.description: SP.Runtime.Mind.of/2 output, computed BY the agent from its own live model and pushed to the board. NOT felt states — see SP.Brain.Awareness, which models access and report, never phenomenal experience.

context.description: L2 Strategist standing context (a control/preference selection, e.g. :forage). NOT a predictive-coding layer.

stress.description: SP.Brain.Hormones.of_context/1 scalar implied by the context. A modulation parameter, not a feeling.

emotion.description: SP.Brain.Emotion dominant LABEL derived from factor precisions. A label over a distribution. Never surface as 'the UNI feels X'.

confidence.description: Awareness.metacognition/1 — precision-weighted peakedness of the agent's own posteriors.

focus.description: Index of the factor with highest precision x peakedness (the 'spotlight' factor).

intent.description: Plan.preview/2 greedy depth-N action rollout. An EXPECTED trajectory under the model, not a commitment.

report.description: Awareness.report/1 one-line reportable statement of the broadcast. The agent describing its computed state; NOT evidence of qualia.

absentNote.description: Explicit statement of what v1a does NOT carry and why. Present so a consumer never mistakes absence for zero.

senses.description: Raw last sense-line map as parsed from the body Port. Verbatim observation channel.

oneOf.title: GET /producer/uni_history/:name
oneOf.description: v1a ALWAYS returns available:false. SP.Runtime.Board is replace-in-place, so no per-frame series exists. Returning an empty frames[] with a stated reason is the honest answer; synthesizing a series would FALSIFY the gate.

lineage_bred_count.description: Count of UNIs carrying a g-prefixed lineage generation. 0 means NO generational turnover is observable — kin spread MUST NOT be reported as generational depth.
